'''Melin Terqu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]] on [[3DC/Green]]. He was in charge of servicing [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that docked on the station. He kept tight control over his resources and would only allow repairs to visiting ships, stopping anyone from performing upgrades or time-consuming modifications.<ref name="H&S" />
